description: Migration adds assets.manufacturer text, model text, vendor_id uuid (composite FK to vendors(tenant, vendor_id)), purchase_cost bigint (cents), purchase_cost_currency text, order_number text

Data migration copies attributes.manufacturer/attributes.model into the new columns, removes those keys, and fills empty model/manufacturer from workstation_assets/server_assets system_info (model, systemModel, manufacturer)

Asset, CreateAssetRequest and UpdateAssetRequest in packages/types gain manufacturer, model, vendor_id, vendor_name (read), purchase_cost, purchase_cost_currency, order_number; Zod schemas in packages/assets/src/lib/schemas/asset.schema.ts and server/src/lib/api/schemas/asset.ts accept them

createAsset, updateAsset, bulkUpdateAssets persist the new fields; vendor_id is validated as a tenant vendor; purchase_cost_currency defaults to the tenant currency when purchase_cost is set without a currency
Asset list and detail queries left-join vendors and return vendor_name alongside the new columns
NormalizedRmmDeviceExtensionSnapshot gains manufacturer and model; shared ingestion writes assets.manufacturer/model on create and on update when the snapshot value is non-empty
Tactical, Level.io, Tanium and Huntress device mappers fill snapshot manufacturer/model from their source payloads when available
NinjaOne syncEngine writes assets.manufacturer/model from the device system block on create and update when non-empty
Migration importer AssetMigrationApplier writes manufacturer and model to the columns instead of attributes

AssetForm and QuickAddAsset add Manufacturer, Model, Vendor (searchable select of tenant vendors with create link), Purchase cost (money input) and Order no. fields, ids asset-manufacturer-input, asset-model-input, asset-vendor-select, asset-purchase-cost-input, asset-order-number-input
AssetBentoLayout Identity tile shows Manufacturer, Model, Vendor, Purchase cost (formatted with currency) and Order no. rows, hidden when empty; getModelName() system_info fallback removed
AssetDetailDrawerClient info grid shows Manufacturer and Model; AssetDashboardClient offers optional Manufacturer and Model columns
Asset list search and AssetCommandPalette match manufacturer and model
All new asset-field strings added to msp/assets.json for every locale
Migration creates asset_statuses (tenant, status_id, slug, label, kind, is_builtin, is_active, display_order, timestamps), PK (tenant, status_id), UNIQUE (tenant, slug), distributed by tenant

Seed migration inserts active, in_stock, maintenance, inactive, retired per tenant and inserts any other distinct assets.status value as a custom undeployable status; tenant bootstrap seeds the five builtins for new tenants
createAsset, updateAsset, bulkUpdateAssets and AssetService reject a status slug that is not an active asset_statuses row (archived allowed only when unchanged)

Actions listAssetStatuses, createAssetStatus, updateAssetStatus (label, kind, display_order), archiveAssetStatus (blocked while in use, returns count) in packages/assets/src/actions/assetStatusActions.ts
Settings > Assets gains a Statuses tab with table, add, rename, kind select, reorder and archive, ids asset-status-*
AssetForm, QuickAddAsset and bulk status action load status options from listAssetStatuses grouped by kind; the hardcoded STATUS_OPTION_VALUES is removed
Dashboard status filter and status breakdown read asset_statuses; AssetSummaryMetrics / health computations use kind = deployable instead of the literal 'active'
Shared ingestion sets status only on create (active, or inactive when offline) and sets retired on deleted/tombstoned; the update patch no longer includes status
NinjaOne syncEngine updateExistingAsset stops writing status; create and delete paths match F022
Migration importer maps a source status to an existing slug when it matches, otherwise active, instead of hardcoding active

Migration creates asset_assignments (tenant, assignment_id, asset_id, contact_name_id, assigned_at, assigned_by_user_id, unassigned_at, unassigned_by_user_id, source, note) with indexes on (tenant, asset_id, unassigned_at) and (tenant, contact_name_id, unassigned_at), distributed by tenant
Backfill migration opens one assignment per asset with a non-null contact_name_id (assigned_at = assets.updated_at, source system)

setAssetAssignee(trx, tenant, assetId, contactId|null, {actorUserId, source, note}) in packages/assets/src/lib/assetAssignment.ts: validates contact belongs to the asset's client, no-op when unchanged, closes open row, opens new row, updates assets.contact_name_id, writes asset_history change_type assignee_changed
createAsset, updateAsset and bulkUpdateAssets route contact changes through setAssetAssignee (source manual); AssetService create/update use source api
Shared ingestion and NinjaOne engine clear contact on client change through setAssetAssignee (source system) instead of a raw null write
Migration importer assigns a contact through setAssetAssignee (source import) when the AMP asset record carries an assignee external identifier that resolves to a contact
clearContactLinksBeforeDelete closes the contact's open asset_assignments (source system) and the contact deletion dependency config lists assets.contact_name_id
Actions getAssetAssignments(assetId) and getContactAssignedAssets(contactId) in packages/assets, returning contact and actor names
AssetAssignment interface in packages/types

Identity tile shows Assigned to as a contact link (opens contact drawer) or Unassigned plus an Assign button (id asset-assign-button) that opens a popover with ContactPicker filtered to the asset's client and an Unassign action; saving calls a new assignAssetContact action
AssetTimeline renders assignee_changed entries as Assigned to X by Y / Unassigned by Y / Auto-assigned to X from {provider} / Assigned to X via bundle Z based on source and note
AssetDetailDrawerClient info grid shows Assigned to
MspClientAssets adds an Assigned to column
Contact details page gains an Assets section listing assets assigned to the contact (name, type, tag, status, link)
AssetDashboardClient bulk action Assign to contact, enabled only when all selected assets share one client, writes through bulkUpdateAssets contact_name_id
Client portal device list (ClientDevicesPage) and AssetDetails show Assigned to (contact name only), fed by the contacts join on client-assets reads
Assignment strings added to msp/assets.json and client-portal.json for every locale
normalizeRmmUsername(raw) in shared/rmm/userMatching.ts returns {key, username, domain, email}; handles DOMAIN\user, AzureAD\First Last, .\user, user@domain, trailing whitespace, lower-casing

matchContactForRmmUser(trx, tenant, clientId, integrationId, provider, normalized) returns {contactId, method: mapped|email|username|name} or null, in that order, considering only the client's contacts and returning null on ambiguity
Migration adds rmm_organization_mappings.contact_assignment_mode text not null default 'suggest' with a check on off|suggest|auto

Shared ingestion, after upserting the extension row, runs auto-assignment when the mapping mode is auto: match on current_user, skip shared-workspace members, assign via setAssetAssignee (source rmm, note raw user) only when unassigned or the open assignment source is rmm; never unassign on empty current_user
NinjaOne syncEngine runs the same auto-assignment step after device upsert
suggestAssigneeFromRmmUser(assetId) action returns {rawUser, normalized, contact, method} or null, and null when the asset is unassigned-ineligible (shared-workspace member) or mode is off

mapRmmUserToContact(integrationId, provider, rawUser, contactId|null, {assignAssetId?}) upserts or deletes the tenant_external_entity_mappings row (integration_type rmm:<provider>, alga_entity_type contact, realm integration id, external id key), assigns the given asset with source manual, and in auto mode assigns other matching assets with rmm/empty assignments
listRmmSignedInUsers(integrationId, externalOrganizationId) returns distinct normalized keys with raw samples, device count, matched contact and method
updateRmmOrganizationMapping actions for Tactical, NinjaOne, Huntress, Tanium and Level.io accept contact_assignment_mode

Live vitals Signed in row appends Looks like {contact} · Assign (id asset-rmm-user-assign) when a suggestion exists, or Map to contact… (id asset-rmm-user-map) opening ContactPicker and calling mapRmmUserToContact with assignAssetId; hidden for shared-workspace members
Shared RmmUserContactMappingPanel in packages/integrations lists signed-in users for an organization with device count, matched contact and method, and a ContactPicker to map or re-map
Tactical mapping UI (CE) adds a People mode select per organization (id rmm-org-people-mode-<id>) and renders RmmUserContactMappingPanel
NinjaOne, Huntress, Tanium and Level.io mapping managers in ee/server add the People mode select and render RmmUserContactMappingPanel
RMM user mapping strings added to the integrations locale namespace for every locale
Migration creates asset_groups, asset_group_members (UNIQUE tenant, asset_id) and asset_group_contacts with the PKs, composite FKs and check constraints in FR-E1, distributed by tenant
AssetGroup, AssetGroupMember, AssetGroupContact, AssetGroupKind interfaces in packages/types; Asset gains group summary {group_id, name, kind} on read

Model layer packages/assets/src/lib/assetGroups.ts enforces invariants: member client equals group client, contact client equals group client, bundle has at most one owner and no users, shared workspace has no owner, shared-workspace member has null contact

Actions createAssetGroup, updateAssetGroup (name, kind, location_id, description), deleteAssetGroup, listAssetGroups(clientId), getAssetGroup(groupId), getAssetGroupForAsset(assetId) with asset permissions

addAssetsToGroup: for a bundle, assigns each new member to the owner (source bundle, note group name) and sets location_id to the group's; for a shared workspace, unassigns members with an assignee (source bundle); rejects assets already in another group or of another client
setAssetGroupOwner(groupId, contactId|null) on a bundle assigns or unassigns every member via setAssetAssignee (source bundle)
updateAssetGroup location change on a bundle updates every member's location_id and writes asset_history on each

addAssetGroupUser / removeAssetGroupUser on a shared workspace; removeAssetFromGroup leaves assignee and location unchanged; deleteAssetGroup removes member and contact rows and leaves assets unchanged
Changing kind shared_workspace→bundle is rejected while users exist; bundle→shared_workspace unassigns members and removes the owner (source bundle)
setAssetAssignee rejects a non-null contact for a shared-workspace member with a typed error used by UI and API
Any client_id change on an asset (updateAsset, AssetService, moveRmmOrganizationAssets) removes the asset from its group and writes group_removed history; client merge is exempt

Asset deletion removes asset_group_members rows; clearContactLinksBeforeDelete removes the contact's asset_group_contacts rows and, when the contact was a bundle owner, unassigns members through setAssetGroupOwner(null)
group_added and group_removed asset_history entries written on membership changes
asset_groups added to CLIENT_OWNED_MOVE_TABLES in clientMergePlan.ts so groups move with the client
getContactSharedWorkspaces(contactId) returns groups where the contact is a user with location and member count

AssetBentoLayout Group tile (id asset-bento-group) shows kind badge, group name opening the group drawer, location, sibling assets with links, and people (owner or users); Related assets tile shows Add to group when the asset has no group

AssetGroupDrawer in packages/assets/src/components/groups: editable name, kind badge, location select, description, Members list with remove and Add assets via ClientAssetMultiSelect (excluding grouped assets), People section (Owner picker for bundle, Users list for shared workspace), Delete group
Group drawer confirm dialogs: adding an assigned asset to a shared workspace explains it will be unassigned; switching bundle→shared workspace explains members will be unassigned

MspClientAssets gains an Assets | Groups segmented control (id client-assets-view-toggle); the Groups view lists groups (name, kind, location, members, people) with New group (id client-assets-new-group) and row click opening the drawer

AssetDashboardClient bulk action Add to group (same-client rule) opens AddToGroupDialog to pick an existing group of that client or create a new one (name, kind); optional Group column and Group filter
Shared-workspace members show Shared workspace: {name} · N people in place of the Assigned to row, and the Assign button and RMM suggestion are hidden
Contact details Assets section adds a Shared workspaces list (group name, location, member count)
AssetTimeline renders group_added / group_removed entries
Group strings added to msp/assets.json for every locale
applyAssetVisibilityFilter with asset_scope contact also includes assets that are members of a shared workspace where the contact or one of their reports is a user
Client portal device list (ClientDevicesPage) and AssetDetails show Shared workspace: {name} for shared-workspace members, fed by the group summary on client-assets reads

getAssetTicketContactOptions(assetId) returns the shared workspace's users; CreateTicketFromAssetButton, portal ticket-from-asset and mobile ticket-from-asset offer them and preselect when exactly one
createTicketForAlert uses the single shared-workspace user as the ticket contact when the alert's asset is a shared-workspace member with exactly one user and no mapping default contact
Migration adds assets.billing_profile_id and rmm_organization_mappings.billing_profile_id (nullable, composite FK to client_billing_profiles)
createAsset, updateAsset, AssetService and RMM mapping update actions validate the billing profile belongs to the row's client and is active, and clear it when client_id changes
resolveAssetBillingProfileId(trx, tenant, assetId) in shared/models or packages/assets lib returns asset profile, else location default profile, else null
createTicketForAlert passes billing_profile_id = mapping.billing_profile_id ?? resolveAssetBillingProfileId when the alert has an asset and the caller supplied none
CreateTicketFromAssetButton, portal ticket-from-asset and mobile ticket-from-asset default billing_profile_id from resolveAssetBillingProfileId when the user did not pick one
AssetForm shows a Billing profile select (id asset-billing-profile-select) only when the client has more than one active profile; cleared on client change; Identity tile shows the row when set
RMM mapping managers (Tactical and the four EE ones) show a Billing profile select per organization only when the mapped client has more than one active profile

moveRmmOrganizationAssets(trx, tenant, mapping, newClientId, actorUserId) in shared/rmm re-points the organization's assets (by rmm_provider + rmm_organization_id or asset external mapping): sets client_id, unassigns via setAssetAssignee (source system), clears billing_profile_id and location_id, removes group membership, writes asset_history, returns moved count
countRmmOrganizationAssets(integrationId, externalOrganizationId) action for the UI confirmation
Tactical, NinjaOne, Huntress, Tanium and Level.io mapping update actions call moveRmmOrganizationAssets in the same transaction when client_id changes
Mapping UIs show a confirmation naming the asset count that will move and that assignees, groups and billing profiles will be cleared, before saving a client change
Shared ingestion update path no longer writes client_id (create unchanged); the contact-clearing branch on client change is removed with it

previewClientMerge returns assets {total, byRmmOrganization[{provider, integrationId, externalOrganizationId, externalOrganizationName, deviceCount}], groups} and billingChoice {unstampedTickets, unstampedProjects, unstampedAssets, unstampedRmmMappings}
Migration adds client_merges.billing_strategy text; executeClientMerge accepts billingStrategy (default source_profile) and records it

executeClientMerge applies billingStrategy uniformly to tickets, projects, assets and rmm_organization_mappings with a null billing_profile_id: source_profile stamps the moved default profile (today's ticket/project behaviour), target_default leaves them null; explicit profiles and billing history tables are untouched
mergeClientIntoParent server action, ClientService.mergeClient and the REST merge + preview routes accept billingStrategy and return the assets and billingChoice blocks

MergeClientsDialog adds an Assets and RMM devices section (id merge-assets-section) listing RMM organizations with device counts, total assets, groups, and a radio Bill merged work and devices under (id merge-billing-strategy) defaulting to the source profile option, with helper text listing affected ticket, project, asset and RMM device counts
Merge section strings added to the clients locale namespace for every locale
GET /api/v1/assets/{id}/assignments returns assignment history; asset create/update/read schemas include the new fields and billing_profile_id
REST /api/v1/asset-groups CRUD, /api/v1/asset-groups/{id}/members (POST, DELETE), /api/v1/asset-groups/{id}/contacts (POST, DELETE) backed by the group model with asset permissions
GET /api/v1/asset-statuses lists the tenant's statuses
OpenAPI route definitions for the new endpoints and fields; spec regenerated and synced via alga-openapi-sync
ee/mobile asset API types and AssetDetailScreen show Assigned to, Manufacturer, Model, Vendor and Group (read-only)
Mobile strings added for every mobile locale
Portal ticket creation (client-tickets.ts asset check) and the portal asset picker use the extended applyAssetVisibilityFilter so a shared-workspace user can raise a ticket on any workspace asset

Portal ticket list and ticket detail under ticket scope contact also include open tickets linked via asset_associations to a shared workspace the contact uses; such tickets are read-only unless the contact is requester or watcher
